title: Quick Smoked Irish Bresaola Grub
description: A simple and salty dinner featuring Irish bresaola, smoked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware cook. This recipe is Ayurvedic sattvic friendly, making it a great choice for those following this dietary path.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware cook to 225°F (110°C) for 30 minutes.
Cut the Irish bresaola into thin slices and place them in the preheated ttukbaegi.
Mix the apple cider vinegar, honey, black pepper, and garlic powder in a small bowl.
Brush the mixture evenly over the bresaola slices.
Add the fresh thyme sprigs on top of the bresaola.
Cover the ttukbaegi with a lid and smoke for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, increase the heat to 300°F (150°C) and cook for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the bresaola from the ttukbaegi and brush with coconut oil.
Top with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional fresh thyme if desired.
